h: Shabbos and Sacred Fruit Repair the First Eating

p: The parsha opens in this way
so that they will be able to rectify
the root of the corruption of the serpent,
and afterward he came upon Chavah
and from this Adam HaRishon became
and from this branched out the one hundred thirty years
And it opens with "You shall be holy";
and it says in Midrash Rabbah
(רֵישׁ פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, וַיִּקְרָא רַבָּה כד, ו)
(at the beginning of this parsha, Vayikra Rabbah 24:6)
which is the rectification of the flaw in eating;
for it is for this that the mitzvah of Shabbos came,
so that he would enter the meal immediately";
the reading is "to the Shabbos meal immediately"
And it is similar to what the holy Zohar writes
"And because of that bread, the food
so that there should be no accusing against them
And just as the eating of the lechem hapanim
on Shabbos was effective for the Kohanim
that it should be in holiness,
and that there should not be in them
any accusation of the evil inclination,
to rectify every flaw of eating,
and so that the eating should be in holiness.
And so it says in the Midrash
"Who will remove the dust from your eyes,
that you could not stand by your command
And it says in the Shach al HaTorah
is from the side of the Tree of Life,
as it says, "Those who taste it merit life"
from the Tree of Knowledge of good and evil,
he would have tasted only from the good in it,
and there would have been no mixing of good and evil;
and this is what it says in Midrash Rabbah:
"that you could not stand by your command
even though the fruit of the Tree of Knowledge
according to the plain meaning of the pasuk.
וְכֵן כָּתַב בְּפָרָשָׁה זוֹ אַחַר כָּךְ
And so it writes in this parsha afterward
that Yisrael should wait three years,
and this will be the rectification
of the flaw of Adam HaRishon.
That is, the entire flaw of Adam HaRishon
was in the fruit of the tree,
for only the fruit of the tree
was given as food to Adam HaRishon.
וּבַזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג פז, ב)
And in the holy Zohar (this parsha, III 87b):
"'In the year' — this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
and we have learned: 'the fourth year'
which stands as the fourth leg of the Throne."
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סוֹף פָּרָשַׁת לֶךְ, מז, ו)
(as they said, Bereishis Rabbah at the end of Lech Lecha, 47:6),
and they are the three legs of the Chariot,
and Dovid HaMelech, peace be upon him,
is the fourth leg of the Chariot,
for he is a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
And it says that in the fourth year
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah;
כִּי שֶׁמֶשׁ וּמָגֵן ה׳ (תְּהִלִּים פד, יב)
"for Hashem is a sun and a shield" (Tehillim 84:12)
this is the Holy One, blessed be He;
And it says in the holy Zohar
the Holy One, blessed be He."
That is, the eating of neta revai
is a rectification of the flaw of Adam HaRishon,
and just as through the eating of Shabbos,
and begin with words of Torah
so through the eating of revai
"all its fruit shall be holy, for praises":
that the mouth will be opened
to say praises with which to praise
the Holy One, blessed be He.
And this is the matter of the dispute (Berachos 35a):
And it is according to what they said
"The tree from which Adam HaRishon ate
Rabbi Meir says it was a vine";
"She squeezed grapes and gave it to him."
וְזֶה דַּעַת מַאן דְּתָנֵי כֶּרֶם רְבָעִי
And this is the view of the one who teaches "kerem revai":
that the rectification corresponding to it
הָיָה גַּם כֵּן רַק בְּכֶרֶם רְבָעִי
is likewise only in kerem revai.
And the view of the one who teaches "neta revai"
הוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּתִּיקּוּנִים
is according to what is written in the Tikkunim
and one said it was a vine,
and so it writes in the Zohar Chadash,
"And others said it was a fig,
and they did not disagree in their words,
nothing was given as food to Adam HaRishon
except the fruit of the tree;
as they said in the Gemara (there, Berachos 40a).
וְזֶה דַּעַת מַאן דְּתָנֵי נֶטַע רְבָעִי
And this is the view of the one who teaches "neta revai":
that the rectification is in every fruit of the tree.
to increase its yield for you."
That is, just as the eating of Shabbos is effective
and like the eating of the lechem hapanim for the Kohanim,
for one who merited the union
of the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
to rectify all the eating afterward,
that it bring holiness into the heart,
the accusation of the evil inclination;
that is, according to the eating:
if, Heaven forbid, it is not in holiness,
there is the accusation of the evil inclination;
and if it is in holiness,
it brings holiness to the heart,
and he has only one heart,
And here is written for the fifth time
which corresponds to the attribute of Gevurah;
for Yitzchak Avinu, peace be upon him,
is a chariot for this attribute;
that he merited everything that is counted
(סוֹף פֶּרֶק א דְּבָבָא בַּתְרָא, יז, א)
(end of the first chapter of Bava Basra, 17a)
"And I will bless you before Hashem, etc.";
for she knew that through his eating
that he should have in mind His Name,
so that it would be eating in holiness,
for the sake of the mitzvah of honoring a father
And likewise the meal of Shabbos night,
which corresponds to the holiness of Yitzchak Avinu,
is alluded to in the pasuk
which is not mentioned with any other "today"
that allude to the holiness of the Shabbos meals.

paragraphs.text: Source: Vayikra 19:25 — “ובשנה החמישת תאכלו את פריו להוסיף לכם תבואתו אני יהוה אלהיכם” — “and only in the fifth year may you use its fruit—that its yield to you may be increased: I יהוה am your God.”

paragraphs.text: Source: Bereishis 27:33 — “ויחרד יצחק חרדה גדלה עד מאד ויאמר מי אפוא הוא הצד ציד ויבא לי ואכל מכל בטרם תבוא ואברכהו גם ברוך יהיה” — “Isaac was seized with very violent trembling. “Who was it then,” he demanded, “that hunted game and brought it to me? Moreover, I ate of it before you came, and I blessed him; now he must remain blessed!””

paragraphs.text: Source: Shemos 16:25 — “ויאמר משה אכלהו היום כי שבת היום ליהוה היום לא תמצאהו בשדה” — “Then Moses said, “Eat it today, for today is a sabbath of יהוה; you will not find it today on the plain.”
